Out. About. Unapologetic.

Queer stories. Find your people. Find your place.

Queer stories. No compromises. No apologies. Stories that refuse to fade into the background. Characters who love fiercely, challenge expectations, uncover secrets and forge their own paths. Our LGBTQ+ fiction explores love, loss, mystery, friendship, belonging and personal challenges and second chances. These are stories where queer characters don't simply exist on the side-lines. They take centre stage. They own their stories. And they make no apologies for who they are.

How to buy our books

  1. Choose a book

    Browse our books and open any title to read the full description.

  2. Pick a format

    Each book page lists the paperback, hardback and eBook editions that are available, with prices.

  3. Buy it your way

    Buy on Amazon, where paperbacks are printed to order and eBooks arrive on Kindle straight away. Some titles are also sold by other shops, linked on the book page.

An independent imprint

Out and About Books is a small, independent publisher. We care more about the road than the destination, and about the people you meet along the way. Every book we publish puts queer lives at the heart of the story, with warmth, wit and a proper sense of place.
